summary: Mildly bullish open: October PPI came in cooler than expected (+0.3% m/m vs +0.4%), SPY ~759 and QQQ ~689 slightly green after Thursday's 0.4% drop, Nvidia bouncing about 2% from 166.19. Single-stock catalysts lead: Cerebras earnings beat, Palo Alto upgrade, Microsoft's global outage, Cisco fading its beat. Prices are from pre-market search snippets (quote pages blocked).

picks.name: Palo Alto Networks
picks.reason: KeyBanc upgrade to Overweight (PT 380) plus a security bid from the Microsoft outage; over pre-market high ~337 runs toward 345.

picks.name: Cerebras Systems
picks.reason: Q3 revenue +55% with raised guidance and a Microsoft deal, up ~19% pre-market; over 120 the gap extends, under 112 it fades.

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Global Outlook/Teams/Copilot outage running 12+ hours, shares down ~2-3%; under 505 extends, a confirmed fix and reclaim of 521 kills the put.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Rebounding ~2% after Thursday's 166.19 close on the Huang resignation, cooler PPI and earnings next week; over 171 the bounce extends, under 166 it fails.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Giving back part of Thursday's 5.9% Nvidia-rotation pop as Nvidia recovers; under 565 extends toward 553, over 581 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Cisco Systems
picks.reason: Selling the news on its FQ1 beat (down ~2% from 102.01); under the 97.70 low extends toward 96, back over 100.8 the fade fails.
